concept: Tide light crosses a dark tiled harbour, alternating drawn geometry and captured motion.
setting: a tiled harbour mouth under a low moon
continuityRules: Keep the horizon in the upper third.
Cyan reads as advancing water, amber as draining light.
The same harbour identity persists across drawn and captured shots.
cameraLanguage: locked wide on the harbour mouth
slow lateral drift with the tide
transitions: hard cut on the approved beat
productionConstraints: Only locally supplied, hash-verified assets may bind.
A shot stays blocked until its media requirement is approved.
No provider generation is authorized in this phase.
assumptions: Directives alternate across generated shots, so drawn and captured shots interleave.
The reviewer, not the analyzer, chooses timing and renderer family.
